output.title: quietpage: Private Journal
output.tagline: Journal with AI reflections, on-device only.
output.description_short: A private journal app with on-device encryption and local AI reflections. No account, no cloud, no tracking.
output.description_long:
quietpage is built for those who value privacy above all. Your entries are encrypted on-device with keys that never leave your phone — no account or email required. Unlike other journaling apps, quietpage never sends your thoughts to the cloud.

The optional AI reflection feature runs entirely on your device using Core ML, so your prompts and entries stay private. You’re in full control: export anytime as plain Markdown with zero lock-in.

Trusted by over 1,900 users in the first month and recommended in r/privacy’s weekly software thread. Our full security model — including key storage and encryption layers — is documented and open to review.

For privacy-minded professionals and journaling enthusiasts who won’t compromise on where their inner life is stored. Your thoughts stay on your phone. Full stop.
